verdict.rationale: Egnyte documents a built-in conversational AI assistant that answers questions, summarizes selected files or knowledge bases, and generates content such as emails and memos. It also offers no-code custom agents that automate processes across content and apps, so users can delegate tasks inside the product. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on how much of a task agents run end-to-end, any limits on what can be delegated, and independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is vendor marketing).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Conversational AI assistant capable of answering questions and summarizing multiple selected files or knowledge bases, and generating content such as emails, memos, proposals, etc.
Custom agents can be built without code using the AI Agent Builder.
Configure agents to automate processes across your content and apps.
Multi-step ad-hoc and template-based workflows with automatic and manual steps, AI steps, and webhooks for external system integration.
